Alan's AutoLogistics is a store in Oaklands. Part of the store is closed; the store's owner, Alan Burk. This is the location where players can purchase components and structures with which they can use logic on their property including a new truck and upgrade for it.

Description

Alan's AutoLogistics appears to be two stores in one. The structure is primarily built out of red brickwork. The neon sign above the store reads "Alan's Autologistics," where the left side for Alan's Auto is written in a varsity font, while the right side for Logistics is written using a fourteen-segment display. While the Logistics side of the store is open for business, the entrance and windows for the Auto side of the store are blacked out to prevent anyone from entering or looking into the store. Curiously, the rear windows are not blacked out. In addition, the lower-left corner of the window is broken, although the reason is unknown. Additionally the Auto side of the store sells the Fever Vinyl and the aforementioned vehicle/upgrade.

Checking behind the cashier's register and looking upwards reveals multiple messages pinned to the upper side of the wall. These messages loosely direct players towards acquiring the Lab Card. This card has Alan's name on it, implying a connection between Alan and the lab.

Trivia

  • This store existed before for a long time in a dilapidated state, but on November 2023, the building was fixed and the Logistics side of the store was opened for business.
  • The signs behind Alan's desk imply that Alan is a girl, however when talked to without purchasing anything, Alan will proclaim that they are the "go-to guy" for logistics. Seeing as "Alen" is a male name and not unisex, this is likely a mistake on the developer's part.
  • The aforementioned signs may be referencing the Junior Scientist, who's not yet a scientist and may be a kid.
